subject: general
question:
Select the antonym of the given word.

taciturn
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"taciturn"** means a person who is reserved or uncommunicative in speech; saying little. **(मितभाषी**)

 
 
• **Example: **Despite his ***taciturn*** nature, he was actually very knowledgeable and observant.
 
 
 
• **"Loquacious"** refers to a person who tends to talk a great deal; talkative. (**बातूनी**)
 
 
• **Example: **She was so ***loquacious ***that everyone in the office knew about her weekend plans by Monday morning.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'taciturn'** is **'loquacious'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Laconic** (**संक्षिप्त**): Using very few words.

 
 
• **Example:** His ***laconic*** reply suggested a lack of interest in the topic.
 
 
 
• **Reticent** (**अल्पभाषी**): Not revealing one's thoughts or feelings readily.
 
 
• **Example:** She was extremely ***reticent ***about her personal affairs.
 
 
 
• **Withdrawn** (**अंतर्मुखी**): Not wanting to communicate with other people.
 
 
• **Example:** After the incident, he became more ***withdrawn*** and avoided social gatherings.
